children: Average daily ethanol production and total ethanol stocks were steady in this week's report from the Energy Information Administration, counter to the wide range of forecasts from analysts surveyed this week.

In its latest weekly report published Wednesday, the EIA said that for the week ended Aug. 28, average daily ethanol production was 1.11 million barrels a day. That's down 2,000 barrels a day from the prior week, which is a much-smaller margin of change versus what was forecast by analysts in Dow Jones survey this week--who had forecast average daily production between 1.082 million barrels a day and 1.122 million barrels a day.

Total inventories were also little moved for the week, drawing down 171,000 barrels from the prior week to 25.04 million barrels. Analysts had forecast stocks between 24.5 million barrels and 25.21 million barrels.
Most-active CBOT corn futures are up 0.3% in trading Wednesday morning, turning positive after opening the day lower.
